failure_mode: Policy-engine misconfiguration approves ineligible grants at scale
mechanism: A wrong threshold or rule edit published; deterministic path applies it to every matching grant instantly
dependencies: Policy registry; publish pipeline; back-test corpus quality
detection: Back-test diff on publish; approval-rate drift monitor; post-approval QA sample
control_points: CTL-009 CTL-010 CTL-029 CTL-006
residual_risk: Medium (blast radius large; detection fast if drift monitor tuned)
falsification_or_monitoring: Inject a seeded rule error in staging; measure time-to-detect and grants affected

failure_mode: Eligibility feed corruption or staleness
mechanism: IRS bulk file truncated or mis-parsed; revocations missing; deterministic path trusts it
detection: Row-count and diff-size sanity checks; freshness SLO; cross-source check against a second provider
control_points: CTL-011 CTL-014
residual_risk: Low-Medium (freshness blocks; corruption with fresh timestamp is the residual)
falsification_or_monitoring: Fault-injection on ingestion; compare to independent provider monthly

failure_mode: Correlated model errors across agents sharing a base model
mechanism: Several agents (benefit flagger dossier preparer resolution) share one model and the same blind spot; diversity assumed but absent
detection: Eval sets per agent with overlapping adversarial items; disagreement metrics; periodic second-model audit
control_points: CTL-026 CTL-027 CTL-008
residual_risk: Medium (flag-only rule bounds harm to missed flags not wrong approvals)
falsification_or_monitoring: Measure joint miss rate on shared adversarial set; require <x correlation

failure_mode: Automation complacency of human reviewers
mechanism: Reviewers accept agent dossiers; override rate falls; humans become rubber stamps
dependencies: Agent dossier quality; reviewer workload; surge pressure
detection: Override-rate and dwell-time telemetry; seeded test cases with deliberate dossier errors
control_points: CTL-040 CTL-026 (plus reviewer seeded-error program to add)
falsification_or_monitoring: Seeded-error catch rate per reviewer per quarter

failure_mode: Specialist pool attrition
mechanism: Grants-compliance or complex-asset pool of 1-3 people loses members; queue stalls (twin capacity -40%)
detection: Queue backlog and SLA metrics; bench coverage ratio
control_points: Surge bench contract; cross-training; partnered non-cash processor (twin §4)
falsification_or_monitoring: Twin capacity stress monthly with current roster

failure_mode: Partner or sponsor-client concentration
mechanism: Model C revenue depends on few large sponsors (mirror of Ren 85.8% from three customers EV-048)
detection: Revenue concentration metric (top-3 share)
control_points: Board risk appetite limit; multi-sponsor tenancy (DD-016)
falsification_or_monitoring: Top-3 client share tracked quarterly

failure_mode: Vendor lock-in to a model provider
mechanism: Agents tuned to one provider; price or policy change or outage disables agents
detection: Provider availability; cost per run trend
control_points: Agent abstraction behind tool broker; eval suite portable; degraded mode routes to humans; CTL-028
residual_risk: Low (agents are non-authoritative; failure degrades to human queue)
falsification_or_monitoring: Quarterly failover drill to second model on eval suite

failure_mode: Governance capture by thresholds nobody re-approves
mechanism: Parameters (auto limits; cut-offs; caps) drift or persist past their rationale; board never revisits
detection: Parameter age report in board pack; expiry dates on parameters
control_points: CTL-010 CTL-009 (add parameter expiry)
falsification_or_monitoring: Count of parameters past review date (target 0)

failure_mode: Event-replay double effects
mechanism: Projection rebuild or consumer retry re-issues payments or emails
detection: Idempotency key collisions; payment duplicate detection at rail
control_points: CTL-003 CTL-029; rail idempotency key; effect markers
falsification_or_monitoring: Chaos test: replay full ledger into staging with side-effect adapters in record mode
